captions.facebook:
FINANCIAL EDUCATION · Education edition

Reading an energy bill

Electricity and gas bills combine the units used, the price per unit and fixed charges.

Looking at each part shows what comes from price and what comes from use.

Hypothetical example: 600 units at 30 cents a unit is $180, before any fixed charges.

Reading the parts of a bill is the first step in understanding why it changed from one period to the next.

Learn. Understand. Stay Informed.
